subject: Renewal uplift: anchoring proposal + prioritized credit bucket
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@beaconhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@beaconhealth.com
Date: Tue, 10 Oct 2028 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Renewal discussion — mid-cycle uplift & co-term question

Hi Karthik,

Quick note from our side — Beacon expects to exceed our committed units in Q4 due to a successful pilot. We’re targeting a ~40% uplift over the current commitment and would like to discuss:

- Pricing for incremental capacity (net of existing commitment)
- Options to co-term the uplift with our annual renewal (we want a single renewal date)
- Any temporary credits or incentives for accelerating the commit now

Procurement attached a short timeline (procurement-timeline.pdf) — they’ll want legal/PO-ready docs by Oct 25 if we want to close before year-end. Can you send a sketch of economics and whether you can do a short-term credit bucket for transition costs?

Thanks,
Alex Rivera
Head of ML Platforms, Beacon Health
alex.rivera@beaconhealth.com

Attachment: procurement-timeline.pdf (application/pdf)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@beaconhealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Oct 2028 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — mid-cycle uplift & co-term question

Alex — great to hear the pilot momentum, congrats. High-level thoughts attached (uplift-pricing-model.xlsx) but summary below: 

- Incremental uplift (40%): propose a tiered effective discount on the incremental units — 8% on first 20% incremental, 12% on next 20%.
- Co-term: we can annualize the uplift to your renewal date by converting incremental units into a mid-cycle amendment that pro-rates to the next annual invoice; no uplift charge if you commit at trial-to-annual conversion.
- Short-term credit bucket: we can offer a prioritized credit pool of $30k to offset migration/ops work; credits apply to usage over the next 90 days.

Next steps: 1) internal align on final legal language and SLA carveouts, 2) I'll send a redline-ready amendment + SOW and DocuSign link. If procurement wants a call, can we target Oct 17 for a 30-min sync?

Cheers,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive — East
Redwood Inference

Attachments: uplift-pricing-model.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: priyom_das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, naomi_feldman <naomi_feldman@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 12 Oct 2028 11:30:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Renewal discussion — proposed economics and credit bucket (internal)

Team — forwarding Alex’s ask and my sketch. Need quick alignment on the following before I send the amendment: 

1) Discount anchoring: is 8%/12% on incremental acceptable from finance? We need margin cover but must be competitive with public providers.
2) Credit bucket: $30k prioritized credit — vote yes/no. If yes, we should require a 6-month minimum renewal on the uplift to avoid churn exposure.
3) SLA language: Beacon asked about SLA guarantees during the uplift window; can we offer a 99.5% availability clause on production endpoints with standard service credits? Legal will need to scope exceptions on experimentation windows.

Suggested compromise: tie the $30k credit to a 9-month committed uplift (minimum), and require that the incremental commit auto-annualizes at the next renewal with a one-time true-up invoice. This preserves commercial upside while protecting us from short-lived spikes.

Can you both reply with quick thumbs by EOD Monday so I can send a clean offer to Beacon?

— Karthik

(On a side note: Naomi, can you plan a short tech call to map KV cache expectations — Alex wanted latency targets documented.)

From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@beaconhealth.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@beaconhealth.com
Date: Mon, 15 Oct 2028 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal discussion — mid-cycle uplift & co-term question

Thanks Karthik — this is helpful. A couple follow-ups from procurement and engineering: 

- Procurement: can you confirm whether the amendment will require a PO or if DocuSign-signed SOW + amendment suffice for SSO? We prefer DocuSign if you support it.
- Engineering: we need a documented latency SLA or an escalation path during the onboarding window. 99.5% availability is acceptable as long as there’s an agreed remediation plan.

Also: the prioritized credit is attractive. Can you clarify whether credits can be applied to past overage charges or only forward usage? Procurement would prefer some backward application for the current spike month.

If you can share a redline-ready amendment and SOW, procurement will review and aim to respond by Oct 23.

Best,
Alex

Subject: Final: Amendment + SOW for Beacon uplift (DocuSign link)

Alex — attaching the SOW and amendment for the uplift (Beacon_SOW_v2.pdf). Key commercial summary below: 

- Incremental uplift: 40% increase in committed units, effective day one of the amendment.
- Discounts: 8% on the first 20% incremental units, 12% on the next 20% incremental units (applied to incremental units only).
- Prioritized credit bucket: $30,000 — can be applied to prior month overage up to $10k and forward usage thereafter (per procurement request).
- Minimum term: 9 months on the uplift; incremental units auto-annualize at next renewal with one-time true-up.
- SLA: 99.5% availability on production endpoints during the uplift window; service credit schedule included in SOW.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/abc123-sign
HubSpot deal: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DL-2028-0871

If that looks good, sign the DocuSign and procurement/legal can route the PO if they prefer — DocuSign is fine for execution. I'll schedule a short onboarding call with Naomi next week to cover KV cache and latency expectations.

Action items:
- Alex: confirm acceptance and sign DocuSign by Oct 25.
- Procurement: confirm whether a PO will follow or if DocuSign suffices.
- Naomi: please propose 2x 30-min slots next week for onboarding.

Thanks — excited to get this live.

Best regards,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Account Executive — East
Redwood Inference
